title: AI Cockpit全面整改执行计划
outOfScope: 除本工单发现的候选发布证据校验流程纠偏外，所有整改工单的生产代码、测试、CI、发布资产和产品文档实现
创建或合并本计划列出的后续工单 PR
发布新版本或删除历史计划/归档证据

sources.path: user-request: AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instruction
sources.reason: User-provided AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instruction.
Repository-required Work Item, PR, archive, close, branch-cleanup, and verification lifecycle.
Canonical AI Cockpit lifecycle and fail-closed rules.

riskAssessment.reason: This Work Item authors and validates an execution plan; future release identity and the recorded release-evidence issue are explicitly deferred to their own Work Item Contracts.

executionDecision.reason: User explicitly authorized continued execution of the complete plan, including recording process issues and completing each Work Item lifecycle before proceeding.

preReviewWarnings: This Work Item produces the plan and its own lifecycle evidence; later Work Items must still establish their own Contract, evidence, PR, merge, closure, and cleanup.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The plan maps all remediation domains and phases to one serial Work Item per review unit.
Every Work Item requires PR, archive, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, base synchronization, and documentation alignment before the next Work Item.
The release Work Item is followed by the final execution-plan cleanup Work Item, with historical evidence retained.

acceptance: The Contract explicitly defines scope, out-of-scope work, sources, acceptance, verification, and user authorization.
The plan maps all 15 remediation areas and 5 phases from the user instruction to serial Work Items.
The plan ends with the Work Item for publishing a new version followed by the Work Item for cleaning execution-plan documents.

Every listed Work Item has a complete lifecycle: latest base, dedicated branch, Contract, preflight, implementation, verification, ai-finish/archive, push, PR, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, base synchronization, and documentation alignment.
The plan requires issue recording, process-first correction, evidence-backed acceptance, and a stop after plan authoring for user confirmation.
The candidate release-evidence comparison process is corrected with regression coverage when the plan PR exposes its pre-existing identity-boundary defect.
Required AI Cockpit checks and document validation are run for this plan Work Item.
guidelines: Do not execute a remediation Work Item before the user confirms this plan; the user has now explicitly authorized full serial execution.

Do not claim remediation implementation, release, or cleanup completion from this plan Work Item; the candidate release-evidence process correction is limited to removing a PR-blocking false failure and its regression test.
Preserve historical evidence; execution-plan cleanup is a separately authorized final Work Item.

intent.problem: The user-provided comprehensive remediation instruction spans installation, evidence, safety, workflow, efficiency, reporting, documentation, enterprise boundaries, code quality, cleanup, and UI signals. It needs one auditable, serial execution plan before implementation begins.
constraints: Each remediation Work Item is independent review unit with one branch and one PR.
A later Work Item cannot start until the predecessor PR is merged, archived, closed, branches are cleaned, and the base is synchronized.
Process defects must be corrected through a process Work Item before the blocked implementation Work Item resumes.
The user must review and confirm this plan before any listed Work Item is executed.
intent.rationale: Serial closure and evidence alignment prevent one large remediation branch from hiding process defects, stale documentation, unmerged work, or unverified release claims.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
